widgets.x: integer, pixels from the left edge
widgets.y: integer, pixels from the top edge
widgets.w: integer; wider than tall = horizontal, taller than wide = vertical (fills from the bottom)
widgets.background: colour name (black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray) or #rrggbb
widgets.max: integer (the bar runs from 0 to max)

widgets.id: text, unique in the whole design (screens and widgets)
widgets.x: integer, pixels from the left edge
widgets.y: integer, pixels from the top edge
widgets.background: colour name (black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray) or #rrggbb
widgets.source: path of the picture on the PC (make_images.py converts it for the board)
widgets.transparent: true | false (true: screen colour shows around the picture)

widgets.id: text, unique in the whole design (screens and widgets)
widgets.x: integer, pixels from the left edge
widgets.y: integer, pixels from the top edge
widgets.w: integer; the line runs from (x, y) to (x + w, y + h); may be 0 or negative
widgets.h: integer; the line runs from (x, y) to (x + w, y + h); may be 0 or negative

widgets.id: text, unique in the whole design (screens and widgets)
widgets.x: ignored: the keyboard takes over the screen
widgets.background: colour name (black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray) or #rrggbb
widgets.target: id of the widget that receives the text (empty = none)
widgets.secret: true | false (show * instead of the typed characters)
widgets.hide_on_enter: true (Enter closes it) | false (Enter sends, keyboard stays open until Esc)
widgets.linefeed: true | false (full layout: adds an LF key)

widgets.id: text, unique in the whole design (screens and widgets)
widgets.x: integer, pixels from the left edge
widgets.y: integer, pixels from the top edge
widgets.h: integer; dropdown: height of the closed field AND of every row in the list
widgets.selected: integer: number of the chosen item (0 = first, -1 = none)
widgets.background: colour name (black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray) or #rrggbb
widgets.font_type: default | a font name listed in target.fonts
widgets.font_size: default | a size listed for that font in target.fonts (built-in font: 8, 16, 24)

widgets.id: text, unique in the whole design (screens and widgets)
widgets.x: integer, pixels from the left edge
widgets.y: integer, pixels from the top edge

items.text: text of the entry (end items have no 'items')

widgets.selected: text path of the last end item chosen, e.g. Network/WiFi (empty = none)
widgets.background: colour name (black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray) or #rrggbb
widgets.font_type: default | a font name listed in target.fonts
widgets.font_size: default | a size listed for that font in target.fonts (built-in font: 8, 16, 24)

widgets.id: text, unique in the whole design (screens and widgets)
widgets.x: integer, pixels from the left edge
widgets.y: integer, pixels from the top edge
widgets.min: number: value at the first mark (lower left)
widgets.max: number: value at the last mark (greater than min)
widgets.value: number: needle position (the script can change it)
widgets.text: caption under the number, empty = none
widgets.ticks: integer 1 to 50: number of intervals between the marks
widgets.diameter: integer: 0 = the largest circle that fits, or 20 to 240 pixels
widgets.sweep: integer 90 to 340: angle of the scale in degrees (270 = three quarters of a circle)

widgets.id: text, unique in the whole design (screens and widgets)
widgets.x: integer, pixels from the left edge
widgets.y: integer, pixels from the top edge
widgets.step: number greater than 0: change per tap
widgets.font_type: default | a font name listed in target.fonts
widgets.font_size: default | a size listed for that font in target.fonts (built-in font: 8, 16, 24)

widgets.id: text, unique in the whole design (screens and widgets)
widgets.x: integer, pixels from the left edge
widgets.y: integer, pixels from the top edge
widgets.color: colour of the line or bars
widgets.points: integer 2 to 300: how many values are shown; the oldest drops out
widgets.title: text at the top left, empty = none
widgets.update_ms: integer 0 to 5000: shortest time between two redraws (very small = the board is busy drawing)

widgets.id: text, unique in the whole design (screens and widgets)
widgets.x: integer, pixels from the left edge
widgets.y: integer, pixels from the top edge
widgets.title: text at the top left, empty = none
widgets.labels: list of texts, one under each bar, e.g. ["2021", "2022"]
widgets.values: list of numbers, one per bar (missing = min)
widgets.update_ms: integer 0 to 5000: shortest time between two redraws (0 = at every change)
